title: Ben Shelakot
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Niddah 52b](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.52b.5-7): Rabbi Shimon said, “Chanina ben Chakhinai found me in Sidon and said: When you reach Rabbi Akiva, say to him: Did not Ben Shelakot testify in the presence of all of you at Yavneh…? When I came to Rabbi Akiva, he said to me: I do not know Ben Shelakot,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The linked baraita gives Ben Shelakot’s position, then the conversation reported by Rabbi Shimon. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3330&lang=en) also records Rabbi Akiva’s reply that he does not know Ben Shelakot.
